title: By one fasting when presented with food and does not break his fast
title_arabic: دعاء الصائم إذا حضر الطعام ولم يفطر
description: Supplication for one who is fasting when presented with food and does not break his fast

duas.english_text: When you are invited (to eat) then reply to the invitation. If you are fasting then invoke Allah's blessings (on your host), and if you are not fasting then eat.
duas.transliteration: Idhā du'iya aḥadukum falya'ib, fa'in kāna ṣā'iman falya'salii, wa'in kāna mufṭiran falya'ṭa'am
duas.arabic_text: إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ
duas.note: When you are invited (to eat) then reply to the invitation. If you are fasting then invoke Allah's blessings (on your host), and if you are not fasting then eat. The meaning of 'invoke Allah's blessings' (falya'salli) is to make supplication/dua (falya'da'u).
